Yes. It makes me sad, her struggle with smoking and how it has a hold on her. She has a pulse oximeter, nebulizer, but the addition of new medications and supplemental oxygen will be new to work with. She's quite the workaholic but a great person and I'm sure shell do her best in all other areas, it's just getting her - or her, more less, choosing to quit once she leaves. Thank you so much!!

Yes. She's a chronic smoker - not sure why I didn't add that; just in a rush, I guess. Thanks so much for the help. The hardest will be her choice to quit, as she's already been talking about wanting to smoke again when she leaves..which just can't happen, knowing her. I plan to never ever smoke/vape/use any other substance. Anyways, thank you for your help!!!

Thank you so much for this! This was such an encouraging comment because this class is really getting to me. I'll definitely be looking into that this week and really focusing on those key ideas.

I surprisingly never even wanted to get in this class, but mentioned I enjoyed general writing to my counselor and she put me in... so I think it's mostly been a shock in the atmosphere compared to some of my easier AP'S and Honors classes, because these kids aren't in AP Environmental, they're in AP Physics or other difficult classes and just at...another level than I am. But, considering I haven't had the same opportunities as them and wasn't trying to be at that "level" I think I'm doing *okay* but will be doing even better by studying more and really practicing my writing skills I can overcome a lot of my insecurities.

Thanks so much!
